limitations: A year appears only when all four quarters are published (the latest complete QCEW year).
UI-covered employment only; excludes self-employed, federal civilian and some agricultural workers.
Total wages move with employment as well as pay (unlike qcew_hawaii_wages.json, which is average pay): this is the series that tracks SOI A00200, the wage base the aging grows.
Trailing revisions through Q3 of year+1 are common (typically <0.5%).
series_id: ENU1500030010 (Hawaii statewide, all industries, total covered, total quarterly wages; the four quarters of a year summed)
title: Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages — Hawaii statewide total wages (all ownership, all industries), calendar-year sum of quarters
